p.src: 1  Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

ja: そこで、私はあなたがたのうちにいる
の一人であり、キリストの
en: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
u.src: 1  Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

p.src: 2  shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

ja: あなたがたのうちにいる
en: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
u.src: 2  shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

p.src: 3  not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

ja: 々に対して威張るのではなく、自ら
en: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
u.src: 3  not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

p.src: 4  When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

en: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
u.src: 4  When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

p.src: 5  Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

en: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
u.src: 5  Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

p.src: 6  Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

ja: でへりくだりなさい。そうすれば、
はふさわしい時にあなたがたを
en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
u.src: 6  Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

p.src: 7  casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

ja: にかけてくださるからです。
en: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
u.src: 7  casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

p.src: 8  Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

ja: ましていなさい。あなたがたの
en: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
u.src: 8  Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

p.src: 9  Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

ja: 界にいるあなたがたの
en: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
u.src: 9  Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

p.src: 10  But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

ja: は、あなたがたをキリスト・イエスによって
してくださいました。あなたがたがしばらく
め、土台を据えてくださいますように。
en: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
u.src: 10  But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

p.src: 11  To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

ja: にありますように。アーメン。
en: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
u.src: 11  To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

p.src: 12  Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

ja: と認めるシルワノを通して、あなたがたに
りました。あなたがたを
しするためです。この恵みのうちに、あなたがたは立っています。
en: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
u.src: 12  Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

p.src: 13  She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

ja: バビロンにいて、あなたがたと
ばれた者が、あなたがたによろしくと
en: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
u.src: 13  She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

p.src: 14  Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

ja: いにあいさつを交わしなさい。 キリスト・イエスにあるあなたがたすべてに、
がありますように。アーメン。
en: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
u.src: 14  Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
